name: Togo

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (single entry, 15 days)
fees.notes: Togo's official e-visa portal (voyage.gouv.tg / dgdn.gouv.tg) confirms all foreign nationals must obtain an e-visa and that fees apply, but its published pages are JavaScript-rendered and did not expose exact fee figures to automated fetch. This amount (25,000 XOF, ~USD 40) is corroborated by multiple third-party visa-service aggregators citing the government eVisa fee schedule; treat as indicative pending direct confirmation on voyage.gouv.tg.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (multiple entry, 30 days)
fees.notes: Reported as USD 80 by aggregator sources; some list 45,000 XOF for this tier and others cite differing XOF/USD splits. Not independently confirmed on the official government portal - verify directly at voyage.gouv.tg before relying on this figure.

fees.name: Tourist e-Visa (multiple entry, 90 days)
fees.notes: Reported as USD 115 by aggregator sources; XOF figure (65,000) reported by another aggregator for the same tier. Not independently confirmed on the official government portal - verify directly at voyage.gouv.tg before relying on this figure.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: Official DGDN (Direction Générale de la Documentation Nationale) page confirms a business visa category exists and is subject to fees, but does not publish an amount. No verified figure found.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No official published fee amount found for a transit visa category.

free_visa_notes: Togo operates ECOWAS free movement for other ECOWAS member-state nationals (no visa required). All other nationalities generally require a visa, obtainable via the official e-visa portal (voyage.gouv.tg) administered by DGDN; no reciprocity/nationality-based fee schedule was found on official sources. No VFS or other outsourced visa application centre was identified for Togo - applications are processed directly online or via the DGDN office/embassies.
